subject: Internet-culture tip: a shared webpage with no permanent owner
text:
Hi Daily Dot team,

A small internet experiment for your web_crawlr coverage: I make Take The Wall, one shared webpage where a newly activated takeover replaces the current featured message or project. The question it poses is what people choose to say when they cannot keep the space forever.

It is an early project, not an established viral trend. A reader can play with the message designer for free here: https://www.takethewall.com/?take=1

Activating a public takeover is separate: there is paid checkout and a reviewed free email-entry route explained in the site rules. No audience size or time on the wall is guaranteed.

Would the premise fit a short internet-culture item or reader prompt? I can answer questions about how replacement and moderation work.
